posts.author: expo
posts.body:
Hey all, I'm super new to RPG Maker (using MV) and was wondering how I can seperate menu options, especially the battle menu.
Bonus points if your'e able to explain how to do this *with images* (I'm using SRD HUDMaker)
Example drawings:

posts.author: NichnotFound
posts.body:
Since you're using HUD Maker, you can press F12 and you'll be able to mess with the positions. I don't know if what you're asking for is what i'm about to explain, but i hope it is.
(I'm a brazilian so that's why the text are in portuguesse)
If that's enough for you, all you have to do is press F12 and click "Menu Editor" and select "ActorCommand", then you mess around with columns and visible rows. For example, i did 2 visible rows and 3 columns, that's why there are 3 options above and 3 below.
Hope i could help out!
